wins.text: Total revenue of $46.7B exceeded outlook; Data Center revenue grew 56% YoY despite a $4B decline in H20 revenue
Networking delivered record revenue of $7.3B, up 46% sequentially and 98% YoY; Spectrum-X Ethernet annualized revenue exceeding $10B
Gaming revenue hit a record $4.3B, up 14% sequentially and 49% YoY driven by Blackwell GeForce GPU ramp
Blackwell Ultra platform generated tens of billions in revenue in Q2; GB300 production ramping at ~1,000 racks/week with acceleration expected in Q3
Returned $10B to shareholders via buybacks and dividends in Q2; Board approved new $60B share repurchase authorization on top of $14.7B remaining

risks.text: H20 China revenue declined to low single-digit % of data center revenue; Q3 outlook excludes H20 China shipments entirely due to unresolved geopolitical/licensing issues
H20 revenue declined ~$4B sequentially in Q2; $2B–$5B potential Q3 upside is contingent on uncertain geopolitical resolution and license approvals
Operating expenses expected to grow high-30s% YoY for full year, up from prior mid-30s% guidance, reflecting accelerating investment spend
Inventory increased from $11B to $15B sequentially to support Blackwell/Blackwell Ultra ramp, creating execution risk if demand softens
USG has expressed expectation of receiving 15% of revenue from licensed H20 sales, though no regulation has been codified — creating policy uncertainty

guidance_items.detail: Q3 revenue guided to $54B ±2%, implying >$7B sequential growth from $46.7B in Q2; excludes any H20 China shipments
Q3 non-GAAP gross margin guided to 73.5% ±50bps, up from 72.7% in Q2; expects to exit year with non-GAAP GMs in mid-70s
Full-year opex growth now expected in high-30s% YoY range, up from prior mid-30s% guidance — a deliberate investment acceleration

analyst_concerns_not_in_prepared: Competitive threat from customer ASICs (e.g., Broadcom) and potential market share shift away from NVIDIA GPUs
Specific breakdown/apportionment of Q3 $7B sequential revenue growth across Blackwell vs. Hopper vs. Networking
Quantitative visibility into FY2026 data center revenue growth rate (e.g., ~50% CAGR bogey)
